script_text:
INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - DAY

RAY (40s, slick, overconfident) paces in front of a floor-to-
ceiling window, smartphone pressed to his ear. A sleek sports car
sits parked visibly on the street below.

                    RAY
          Tell the sponsors we want the deal by Friday.
          If they walk, another brand is already circling.

He hangs up, pours a drink, and grabs the remote. The TV plays
a clip of a man in a yellow hazmat suit cooking in an RV --
clearly an homage, not a direct copy.

                    RAY (CONT'D)
          (to himself)
          Every empire starts with one good batch.

His assistant, DENISE (30s), enters holding a plain coffee cup,
no branding visible.

                    DENISE
          Ray, legal called. They said the script
          references "that superhero's voice" one too
          many times. Might want to cut that.

                    RAY
          Fine. Change it to "some deep, gravelly voice."
          Nobody'll notice.

Denise sets a folder on the table. On top: a sketch of a
fictional tech CEO, clearly stylized, not based on anyone real.

                    DENISE
          Also -- the soundtrack list now has three
          original score tracks instead of the old ones.

                    RAY
          Good. That's one less headache.

FADE OUT.
